messages:
Samir Patel: urgent — AcmeHealth POC is blocked. CISO says we need a detailed data-flow diagram + written SLA commitments before their security review. They want an exec-level touchpoint (CTO or CISO) by EOD. Can we mobilize?
Nina Gomez: on it. just got the ask from their AE — they escalated to their legal/security team.
Devon Li: I can draft the data-flow diagram. need to confirm what we can share for Private vs Hosted flows. is this for hosted API or dedicated?
Samir Patel: it's hosted for the trial but they might move to dedicated. primary ask: where data persists, retention, telemetry exported to third parties, and encryption at rest in our region.
Priya Nair: hosted behaviour: request bodies are transient; logs are scrubbed per PII policy. we store embeddings temporarily for cache only if customer opts in. full spec here: https://redwood.internal/docs/hosting-data-flow (internal link)
Devon Li: copying that into a visual. quick question — they also asked about KMS integration and BYO key for PII. we currently support BYO KMS on Dedicated/Private only. need to confirm if we can provide a contractual attestation for hosted.
Claire Ortiz: legal: we can provide a hosted attestation describing encryption at rest and access controls, but BYO KMS requires Dedicated/Private. I'll draft language for the attestation and propose an SLA snippet for data handling and incident notification windows.
Nina Gomez: can we put together an exec brief for their CTO that summarizes tradeoffs (time to prod, security posture, price delta)? they want this before the bridge.
Samir Patel: yes — they asked for cost delta numbers too. need a ballpark committed throughput + monthly reserved vs on-demand pricing.
Devon Li: I'll include estimated GPU hours for their target throughput (100 concurrent sessions, avg seq len 512) — expect ~ 3x cost on on-demand vs reserved. will add numbers.
Priya Nair: ops note: to meet their SLA we need to guarantee <200ms median token latency for L3 model; that is only supported on Dedicated in EU region with our current pools. hosted can do <300ms but not guaranteed.
Claire Ortiz: flagging risk: if they require SLA-backed latency we must route them to Dedicated and include indemnities in the contract. I'll need legal + sales to approve before we promise anything on the bridge.
Samir Patel: ok — plan: 1) Devon produce data-flow diagram + pricing delta table 2) Claire prepare attestation + suggested SLA language 3) Nina schedule exec bridge (CTO + CISO) for tomorrow morning 4) Priya confirm any infra blockers for an expedited Dedicated evaluation. owners assigned?
Devon Li: I own the diagram + pricing table. ETA: 3 hours.
Claire Ortiz: I own the attestation + SLA draft. ETA: 4 hours.
Priya Nair: I will validate infra and confirm whether we can provision a Dedicated eval cluster in 48 hours.
Nina Gomez: I'll book the bridge for 09:00 UTC tomorrow and invite their CTO + CISO + our execs (Samir, Claire, Priya).
ops-bot: deploy job #8421 succeeded — artifact: acme-poc-templates v2.1
Samir Patel: thanks all. @Devon please include the short cover note for execs (one-pager). Claire, can you add a non-technical tl;dr in the SLA doc for execs?
Claire Ortiz: yep — will add an executive summary and call out appendix for technical details.
Devon Li: added the diagram (push to /shared/acme/dfd.png) and the pricing table (sheet link). ping me if you want me to walk through it on the bridge.
Nina Gomez: bridge scheduled and invites out. Acme's CISO requested our Head of Product if possible — Samir can you escalate for product presence?
Samir Patel: pinged @HeadOfProduct in DMs. also looping in execs: we should avoid promising BYO KMS on hosted — mark as blocker.
Priya Nair: noted. if they insist on BYO KMS we need to propose Dedicated pilot and provide timeline/cost.
Samir Patel: final: we'll aim to present two paths on the bridge: quick hosted trial with attestation vs Dedicated pilot with BYO KMS + SLA. Thanks team — update thread when docs uploaded. :thumbsup:
